card1.heading: To the one who makes every ordinary day feel like something worth remembering
card1.p1: There are people you meet and then there are people who quietly change the entire colour of your world. For me, you are that person.
card1.p2: Every moment with you is its own small miracle. Thank you for being exactly who you are.

card2.heading: Things I love about you
card2.p1:
The softness in your eyes when you talk about things that matter to you.
The way you laugh fully, without holding back.
The way you sleep comfortably when I am with you (in call for now).
The way you eat.
The way you read the things I write for you.
The way you throw tantrums with me.
How you deeply care for your pets and people around you.
The way you treat me.
Well, I think I can't list it all here. I love everything about you.

cake.message: May this birthday bring you all the things your heart has been quietly hoping for and a few things it didn't even know to ask for yet because you deserve it all baby.

timeline.desc:
The moment I first saw you, something shifted quietly, permanently.
Though I never talked much about you with anyone but the very first day, I saw you in a different way comparison to others believe it or not. but I kept it to myself.
I don't know what was it that made me feel something different, something unique. I always observed you but never had the courage to speak. I always noticed you but never talked to anyone about it and I am really happy and grateful now that I get to talk to you every second of my day and talk to everyone about you openly because you are mine now and I am happy I can brag about having someone as special as you only for myself.

So, after we talked for the first time in 2025-12-19 yes I am talking about the day where we actually talked till the night not the small talks we had before and rest is history now I am head over heels for you.
I got to learn a lot about you after that and the fact that I felt so comfortable that day even thought it was the first time of us talking like that made me wonder it was like two close friends catching up after a long time well maybe we were meant to be with each other but since that day I learned a lots of things about you and I want to learn more about you so please tell me everything about yourself.

2026-01-31 (At 10:59) the day I confessed you well a lot happened before confessing but at that exact moment I realized that yes I love her and I can't see her crying anymore and even if she cries I want to be there for her and can't let her cry and overthink alone, I want to take care her, give her love, adore her and make her feel very very special so that she never cries for something like this actually thats not it when you cried before we started dating (not that exam time that was misunderstanding but that was the first time I saw you 😭) you cried because you missed me that made me feel a bit special and guilty.
Special because someone misses me soo much that she cried for me to come back and guilty because I could not do anything while you were crying there alone I could not be there for you.
Also remember the day I gave you a chocolate for the first time? That moment still melts my heart you reaction was just so cute I could kiss you right there I wish I could've hugged you but well there is nothing I can do.
I want to talk about our past soo much like each and every day but we will do that someday again and refresh all our memories.
 Oh and how can I forget our first official date? On the day of Jocund or Valentines honestly that day was soo overwhelming for me because I wanted to make sure I did everything right, the gifts, the way I give it to you, the way I behave when I am somewhere out with you, the way I eat the way I treat you like each and every thing made me concious even thought we were really comfortable with each other on top of that hiding this date from half of our classmates since all of them did not know about this and making sure no one sees us specially our parents or relatives omg that day was really tough but it was completely worth it, each and every second was worth it.
You were looking so pretty that day (you always do still) I could not take my eyes off you and that hairclip suited you smmm and I was really happy to see you happy and the cake was really good too so yeah lets go out on such dates often (not too often tho we are already in a lot of trouble because of people finding out) so lets be cautious🤗 and make more fun memories together.

Your birthday, a day to celebrate the extraordinary person that you are.
You are so emotional about very small things and thats so kind like you literally cry for others and you even cried because I was too nice to you obviously I am nice to you baby you deserve everything and I will make sure I give you everything you deserve. Listen I don't know what happened in your past even though you told me everything I don't really care about it and its not something that we should remember either you met wrong people and wrong time but I am grateful to them since they are the reason why I can call you mine now and have you all for myself and guess what you met the right person at the right time (yes I am talking about me proudly "your proud gulam"). I don't know why do you always keep on thinking that I would cheat on you and you don't deserve this kind of love when YOU CLEARLY DO you deserve even more that I am not able to give you right now but I will be able to give you that kind of love someday don't you ever dare think that you don't deserve me (i've lost the count of how many times i told you this) you deserve the best and I am the best for you. You listed the reasons you could leave me for but the reasons you mentioned the future you mentioned about does not even exist and I wont let you exist in it either I don't know how can you think soo negative when you can be optimistic in the most stupid things sometimes (yeah that was mean but you deserve this too for saying "you will cheat on me someday"🥰). I don't know when you will start trusting me but (mere paas tum raho, jaane ki baat na karo.    mere saath tum raho, jaane ki baat na karo) I was listening to this song while wiritng😭 but see the lyrics are expressing exactly what I am trying to say. Just stay with me no matter what be by my side and don't even dare thinking about leaving me for those silly reasons that never existed, nor it exists now and will not exist in future so just trust me blindly. I know all of these things I am saying now are filmy and very dramatic and this might be the most typical thing that every average lover would say but its me and I am not average I don't like being average  all these things might be a bluff for you now but wait and watch till I prove each and every word I am saying at this moment to be true.
So today on 30th of Baisakh a very special day, on the exact day when you were born 17 years ago I Swapnil Mainali promises you that I shall never cheat you, never do anything that might disappoint you, stay by your side no matter you are right or wrong, support all your decisions (correct the wrong ones obviously), and be by your side and love, adore and cherish you till the very end (i.e death) yeah this was all dramatic but I am going to be more dramatic here (so that these things are engraved in your mind at least till your next birthday). So Sophiya Prasai (it might be too early for this now and i am even being toooo dramatic but I DON'T CARE) will you marry me? (Say YES chup chap🥰).

Everyday I get to learn more and more about you and the more I get to know about you the more I love you so stay with me for ever and give me reason to love you more everyday i.e just exist with me. I will always be there for you no matter what so let be stand beside you and support you through out your life, let me take care of you when you are sick, let me tie your shoe lace every time it unties, let me carry you when your feet hurts and be your legs, let me be your chef who feeds you when ever you are hungry and there are still a endless list of things that I want to do for you so please let me be by your side forever keep me with you and never let me go anywhere (not that I will go anyway because I belong only to you and no one else in this world no one except you deserves me)

I feel really guilty I made a whole page telling that you can trust me blindly and rely on me completely yet it feels like a empty promise after what happened today and I know you are still mad about it and its valid too because it was all my fault for making you rely on me and I was not able to help you at the end even though I tried I failed and thats what matters but please can you forgive me completely and forget whatever happened today and give me one more chance again I promise you that you and trust and rely on me completely and this time I swear that its not a empty promise I love you sooo much baby so please forgive me.

peek.text: This letter holds everything I've ever wanted to say but couldn't quite find the right words. Even now I don't think I will be able to express it all, but let's see how much I really can express.

letter.p1: If you are reading this, it means you found your way to this page. I mean I could've made this a bit harder for you by making the password tricky and making you guess it yourself, but since I am too kind to you and I don't want to ruin this surprise either, I made it easy this time. But yeah, in the near future I might make things hard for you so better start preparing because I won't tell you the password myself while you are making tea next time onwards 😘
letter.p2: I wrote this not because I had to, but because some feelings are too large for just a conversation. At that moment I might not be able to tell you the things I actually think since I am bad at expressing. I don't know why I keep repeating that while writing paragraphs long enough to make you a week older by the time you finish reading them. But I love you sooo much that I want to make you feel loved and seen all the time and I hope I am succeeding in doing that. If not, I'll try harder and become the best person for you.
letter.p3:
On your birthday, I want you to know you are seen, cherished and deeply appreciated not for what you do, but for who you are. You were always loved by me, you are always loved by me and you will always be loved by me. And since you keep asking me things like "am I fat?", "would you still love me if I was fat?", "would you still love me if I was ugly?" or making weird faces and asking "would you still love me if I looked like this?" listen carefully. You were never my option, you were my choice. I chose you because I thought you were the right person for me and guess what? I was right for the first time in my life. I think you are the best decision I ever made. And yes, I would love you no matter how you look. You are the prettiest, cutest and most adorable anyway. Nothing will ever disgust me because I want to love you in your best and worst times. By worst, I even mean when you are sick too because who knows what kind of disease we might get someday? I got a bit confused while trying to explain this but you understood I guess. I just mean to say you can always be comfortable around me. You never need to worry when it's me because IT'S ME. Why would I ever judge you? I'm saying this because you deleted that voice message of you singing that day. Listen, you told me about that past incident when you tried singing in front of people but things like that happen. You can't give your best all the time. You have the most beautiful voice and you sing beautifully. I could listen to you talk and sing all day, even if you scold me. Though I would prefer you not to because what if I cry?🥹 Oh and just so you know the old promises that I made to you are still valid (they have no expiry date) like you can always call me, always share anything we me no matter my mood I'll always listen to whatever you have to say whatever you problem is and even if you call me midnight (10,11,12,1,2,3...) no matter what the clock is saying ignore it and just call me as soon as you need me with 0 hesitation don't care if I am sleeping or even sick just call me thats it. Also let me remind you again that all the love I give you and whatever I do for you I do it all because you deserve it and because I love you, I am just doing the bare minimum things I should be doing for you as a boyfriend since I am going to marry you no matter what so never question about what you deserve or not I will decide that and give you the best treatment possible because you deserve everything and I am just doing my boyfriend thing and I must do it because I am your boyfriend and NO I will never explore any better option because I have the best choice I made in my life (CHOICE not OPTION) so yes I love you smmmmmmm and stop overthinking from now on (if you do i'll mix chilly powder on the chocolates I give you next time🥰)
Sometimes I wonder that our life could’ve so different, there were so many different paths we could’ve walked which could’ve led us to very different lives even that trajectory of orange peel could’ve been so different but the thing is IT DID NOT and now that we are here together when I look back I think this what I want and I can’t even imagine walking the other paths where you were not there with me I can’t even imagine the orange peel flying some where else nor can I imagine “what if I did not text you that day?” even the thought of this scares me that just a single different event could’ve led me some where else where we lived different lives. If multiverse is real I think I am the luckiest Swapnil in existence because I don't think the Swapnils of other universe ended up with you due to different events but thank fully in our universe everything was alligned so perfectly that we found each other, trusted each other, explored more about each other and we fell in love with each other and are still falling deeper in love with each other and I hope we reach the point of no return (from love). I think this is all god's plan that we met together (i said this a long while ago too) and I think he really wanted us to be together so lets respect him, lets not let his efforts be wasted and lets be together forever and lets celebrate us being together everyday because us in other universe were not lucky enough to be together. (I don't know what I am writing at this point I am just yapping about my hypothesis but I hope you enjoyed and understood what I am trying to say I simply mean that I am really grateful that we met and fell in love and I can't afford to lose you ever, you are way tooo precious to me and I love you smmmm)
letter.p4: When we first started talking, I honestly thought we would just become really good friends because who would've thought you liked me that way😭 But I am genuinely happy that you chose me and I promise I will never let you regret it. Thank you for loving me and thank you for letting me love and care for you. Thank you for giving me the right to call you mine and only mine. And yes, you get paranoid a lot and keep saying I will find someone better and that you won't hold me back, but listen to me carefully: there is no one better than you. I will never cheat on you and I will make sure the decision you took by choosing me becomes the best decision you ever made. You can trust me completely. If you ever overthink, call me and scold me for no reason and I would still smile at the end and say "I love you smm dallu." Happy birthday baby. Enjoy your day and let's celebrate your next birthday the same way ~ our own small silent celebration that no one knows about.
